name: User Tools
description: Right-click a person in a server to keep disconnecting, server-muting or server-deafening them whenever they are in a voice channel where you have the permission (Move, Mute or Deafen Members). Discord decides what is allowed. /usertools-list and /usertools-clear show and switch off everything.
